name: The Catastrophe
detailed_description:
Embark on a relaxing, light-hearted space adventure in this 2D spaceflight simulation! In The Catastrophe, you take on the role of a pilot navigating your spaceship through a vibrant, pixel-art cosmos. Your mission is simple but essential — rescue the lost catstronauts scattered across the vast expanse of space and return them safely.

Key Features

  • Weight-Based Mechanics: The more catstronauts you have on board, the more weight your ship gains, affecting its maneuverability. Additionally, the amount of fuel you have also contributes to your ship’s mass, further influencing your ability to navigate through tight spaces and avoid obstacles.

  • Obstacles and Hazards: Dodge asteroids, mouse bombs, and other space dangers while staying on course to find all the lost catstronauts. The deeper you venture into space, the more challenging the environment becomes.

  • Charming Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in a visually delightful world where everything—from the fish-shaped spaceships to the feline-themed obstacles — is designed with cute, quirky charm.

  • Relaxing, Casual Gameplay: Enjoy a peaceful experience with no time limits or stressful penalties. Perfect for unwinding while still offering a fun challenge as you manage your ship’s stats.

short_description: Set off into space on your personal spaceship and rescue all the lost catstronauts! Navigate through flying obstacles while managing fuel and health. Don’t forget to watch your ship’s weight — it affects your maneuverability. Enjoy a relaxing gameplay experience with pixel art and cozy cosmic vibes!
